reporting-org.narrative: King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Centre

title.narrative: Protection services for the most vulnerable families of the displaced and refugees

description.narrative: 1. Legal aid and support for accessing documents for displaced persons and refugees. 2. Providing psychological and social support and specialized protection services to the most vulnerable groups. 3. Providing health care services to refugees and displaced persons. 4. Providing awareness activities for refugees and displaced persons.

5,000 refugees received legal awareness and individual legal assistance 25,000 displaced people received legal awareness and individual legal assistance 14,000 displaced people received identity cards and other civil documents 10,000 refugees were registered and obtained legal documents 1,200 Somali refugees returned voluntary return from Yemen to Somalia 4,000 refugees received support Psychological 10,000 displaced persons received psychosocial support 900 refugee survivors of gender-based violence received protection support and services 6,000 refugee and displaced children at risk received protection support and services 55,500 refugees received medicines and medical supplies in health care centers 5,600 refugees were Referred to healthcare services 11,500 IDPs and refugees benefited from community awareness-raising activities

Promote a protective environment for the displaced and refugees by providing: access to registration and documentation services, legal assistance, specialized services for people with special needs and the elderly and promoting awareness in the community.
